# PC Review — 2004 Windows XP graphics report

- Original title: graphics dilemma with Robin Hood
- Source: [Original publication](https://www.pcreview.co.uk/threads/graphics-dilemma-with-robin-hood.514210/)
- Author / publisher: Guest signing as Manuel; reply by Jimmy S.; PC Review forum
- Language / date: English; 2004-07-29
- Access: Both posts inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

Manuel reports repeated screen blinking and rectangular cursor trails after roughly ten minutes of gameplay on Windows XP. The reply offers general driver, DirectX, and display troubleshooting but does not establish a cause or include a confirmed successful outcome.

This is evidence that superficially similar graphics symptoms were reported well before later compatibility wrappers and modern Windows editions. It does not establish that the underlying cause matches the [DxWnd flipchain issue](dxwnd-flipchain-investigation.md). No graphics-card model, precise game version, or diagnostic log is included.
